use_case: AI resume screening and candidate ranking (ATS add-on scoring applicants against each requisition)
business_owner: Staffing talent acquisition vice president (system owner: Group talent acquisition technology director)
vendor_or_model: Third-party AI vendor integrated into the GWP ATS
data_categories: Resumes; application answers; work history; certifications; prior ATS activity (no SSNs, I-9 data, consumer reports, or self-identification data)
human_in_the_loop: Recruiters review ranked lists; auto-advance of scores 75 and above on Commercial requisitions since 2025-09 (to be turned off 2026-10-31)
applicable_laws: Title VII 42 U.S.C. 2000e-2(b), (k); ADEA 29 U.S.C. 623(b); ADA 42 U.S.C. 12112(b)(6); NYC Local Law 144 (NYC Admin. Code 20-870 et seq.); CPPA ADMT rules (11 CCR 7200 et seq., from 2027-01-01); Colorado SB26-189 (from 2027-01-01); Illinois HB 3773 (Public Act 103-0804; partially verified); Fla. Stat. 501.171(2) (vendor security)
status: In production with conditions (all divisions since 2025-05)

use_case: Conversational recruiting assistant (text): pre-screening knockout questions and interview scheduling
data_categories: Candidate phone numbers; answers to screening questions; availability
human_in_the_loop: Candidates who fail a knockout question are closed automatically (to change: routed to a recruiter)
applicable_laws: Title VII 42 U.S.C. 2000e-2(b), (k); ADA 42 U.S.C. 12112(b)(6); state fair chance laws (generic); NYC Local Law 144 if used for NYC requisitions; CPPA ADMT and Colorado SB26-189 from 2027-01-01; TCPA consent (owned by marketing compliance)
status: In production (Commercial branches); knockout library frozen

use_case: Clinician shift matching and pay-rate recommendation
vendor_or_model: In-house model on the workforce data hub
data_categories: Clinician credentials; shift history; preferences; distance; historical pay rates
human_in_the_loop: Schedulers choose offers; recommended rates are reviewed by the desk manager
applicable_laws: Title VII 42 U.S.C. 2000e-2(k) (pay and assignment effects); state pay equity laws (generic); CPPA ADMT (compensation decisions) from 2027-01-01

use_case: Bank-change fraud scoring (holds risky direct deposit changes for confirmation)
data_categories: Bank-change events; device and network signals; account history
human_in_the_loop: Payroll fraud analysts release or reject every held change within 1 business day
applicable_laws: State wage-payment laws (generic; holds must not delay pay); Fla. Stat. 501.171(2)

use_case: Hospitalization risk model (flags patients at risk of hospitalization for extra visits)
data_categories: Diagnoses; functional assessment items; age; prior utilization (PHI)
human_in_the_loop: Clinicians decide every care plan change; the score never changes visit frequency on its own
applicable_laws: 45 CFR 92.210 (inputs include age and disability-related items); HIPAA; Colorado SB26-189 carve-out for HIPAA covered entities (except employment decisions)

use_case: Ambient documentation pilot for home visits
vendor_or_model: Ambient documentation vendor (speech-to-text and language model)
data_categories: Visit audio; transcripts; draft visit notes (PHI)
human_in_the_loop: Clinician reviews, edits, and signs every note
applicable_laws: HIPAA (vendor BAA with no-training terms); state recording consent laws (Fla. Stat. 934.03(2)(d) worked example); FTC Act Sec. 5 (vendor claims)
status: Pilot in 6 agencies; expansion paused until consent is recorded

use_case: Generative drafting assistant for consultants (deliverables, meeting notes)
vendor_or_model: Approved enterprise generative AI service (no-training terms)
human_in_the_loop: Consultants review all output before use
applicable_laws: Client contracts and BAAs (PHI prohibited unless covered); HIPAA 164.502(a)(3) if PHI is entered; FTC Act Sec. 5

use_case: Claim denial-prediction model built for hospital clients (revenue cycle engagements)
vendor_or_model: In-house model trained on client claims data
human_in_the_loop: Client billing staff decide on every claim; model output is advisory
applicable_laws: HIPAA business associate duties (164.502(a)(3); 164.504(e)(2)(i)(B) data aggregation only if each BAA permits); client contracts; Colorado SB26-189 developer duties to be reviewed by counsel
status: In production for 9 clients; pooled training paused

use_case: Enterprise generative AI assistant (email, documents, chat)
vendor_or_model: Approved enterprise generative AI service (no-training terms)
human_in_the_loop: Users review output; prohibited for hiring, pay, clinical, or client decisions
applicable_laws: POL-05 4.8; Fla. Stat. 501.171(2); HIPAA if PHI is entered

use_case: Generative drafting of job ads and candidate messages in the ATS
human_in_the_loop: Recruiters edit and approve every ad
applicable_laws: Title VII 704(b), 42 U.S.C. 2000e-3(b) (no prohibited preferences in ads)
